concepts.summary: Play-action crossers with a Can to a zone answer the page does not name. Cross: the tagged man runs a High Cross at 18 to 22 between the numbers and the hash as the first read while a Fly Wide sets the depth as the second; the Check Flat at 3 to 5 is the outlet. F High (Paddy Insert cell) layers a low and a depth-set shallow cross under the High Cross with H on a Check Over and an outlet at 5. Mexico (Milf Frog) stacks a low and a high shallow cross with a Fly on top and H on a Check Thru at 5.
concepts.progression: Cross: 1 High Cross, 2 Fly Wide. Mexico: 1, 2, 3 printed on the low cross, high cross and Fly, order unclear
concepts.qb: Back deepens and sells the fake on the Paddy Fly and Milf Frog cells and has the secondary blitz in every cell. Can to the zone answer.

positions.tagged: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash (Z or X)
positions.fly wide: Fly Wide, depth setter (Paddy Fly cell), letter unclear
positions.F: High tag: High Cross over the two shallow crosses (Paddy Insert cell)
positions.shallow crosses: S.C. (Low) and S.C. (Depth Set) in the Insert cell; S.C. (Low) and S.C. (High) in the Mexico cell, letters unclear
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Cross); Check Over (Insert); Check Thru at 5 yds (Mexico); has the secondary blitz

alerts: Alerts printed on the Insert and Mexico cells, targets unclear
